item.title: New beta exam: AZ-401 Designing and Implementing Microsoft Agentic DevOps Solutions
item.description:
Show you are ready to design and run agentic DevOps with new Exam AZ-401 (beta).

Delivery teams are bringing AI agents into planning, building, testing and releasing software, and they need people who can set those agents up with the right guardrails. Exam AZ-401: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Agentic DevOps Solutions is now in beta. The beta period for Exam AZ-401 begins on October 14, 2026.

The first 300 people who take Exam AZ-401 (beta) on or before October 28, 2026, can get 80% off. Choose the discount code in your Microsoft Learn exam registration.

We expect general availability of this certification in January 2027. Beta scores arrive after the beta period closes.
